name: The Alexander, A luxury Collection Hotel
positioning: The Alexander, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Yerevan: contemporary luxury hotel with subtle Armenian design in the historic center of Yerevan
best_for: Travelers who want a central base in Yerevan's historic center
Guests who want a spa, hammam and indoor pool in a city hotel

facts.text: The hotel is set in the historic center of Yerevan, at 3/4 Abovyan Street.
The nearby subway station is Republic Square.
Room design uses solid, straight lines, graphic patterns and muted tones.
Some room types have in-room whirlpools.
Wellness facilities include a spa, an indoor pool and a hammam.
The spa offers couples massages, in-suite massages, facials, body wraps and scrubs, and a steam room.
The fitness center is open around the clock and is complimentary for in-house guests.
Gabriel's Patisserie on Abovyan Street offers French and Armenian confections.
The Keys Cigar Lounge has displays of wines, high-end spirits and cigars, suited to private gatherings.
Service includes turndown, 24-hour room service and twice-daily housekeeping.
The hotel is Green Key certified.

highlights.text: The Alexander is Yerevan's first internationally branded luxury hotel.
Alexander Spa by Anne Semonin features the French skincare house, with bespoke treatments and skincare rituals.
Guestrooms and suites have contemporary elegance with subtle Armenian design and warm gold accents, and rooms look over the lively center of Yerevan.
Named suites include the Pushkin and Abovyan suites and the Alexander Presidential Suite.
Italiano Ristorante is on the top floor, serving Italian dishes and wines with a view over the city center.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
The hotel has no electric vehicle charging stations.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
